name: Hulu Student Discount
description: Disney+ and Hulu bundle for $6.49/month (50% off) for college students
fullDescription: Hulu offers college and grad students the ad-supported Disney+, Hulu Bundle for $6.49/month (normally $12.99), a savings of 50%. Available through SheerID verification.
whatTheyOffer:
- Disney+, Hulu Bundle (with ads) for $6.49/month
- 50% off the regular $12.99/month bundle price
- Full Hulu streaming library plus Disney+
- Discount lasts as long as your student status stays verified
howToGetIt:
1. Visit hulu.com/student
2. Create your account and verify enrollment through SheerID (school name and email)
3. Must be a U.S. resident, 18+, enrolled at an accredited U.S. degree-granting college or university
4. Log in to the Hulu and Disney+ apps with the same email and password
5. After student status ends, price goes to the regular monthly rate
keywords: Hulu, Disney+, student discount, student bundle, streaming, TV shows, movies, college, university
